items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: Leroy, a fellow named Leroy Smith. A colored officer. He was out of Detroit. He actually was the man that put us wise through those fellas up there.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the other bands that were active in New York at that time?

Well, there were a few of them up there. There was one band from Detroit, I think, was playing up there. Leroy, a fellow named Leroy Smith. A colored officer. He was out of Detroit. He actually was the man that put us wise through those fellas up there. You know, such as trying to hire your key men and break up your aggregation and things like that, you know. Did anybody try any of that with a fit-on band? Yeah, well we had several offers. I couldn't say it was that, but they tried to hire our men. Some white…
Now did you say you knew that any of the men in the band played with other orchestras? Or didn't play with other orchestras?
